title: Annual snapshot totals and classification coverage
description: One row per year: all snapshot works, distinct work IDs, works without a joined primary-topic field, and label consistency.
code: select publication_year, count(*) n, count(distinct work_id) unique_works, count(*) filter(where t.field_id is null) unclassified, count(*) filter(where t.field is distinct from w.primary_field) name_mismatch from works w left join topics t on w.primary_topic_id=t.topic_id group by 1 order by 1;
